title: Global derived Hom complex
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let D(\mathcal O_X) be its derived category of \mathcal O_X-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Put A=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X) and let p:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(\{\mathrm{pt}\},A) be the morphism of ringed spaces to the one-point space with structure ring A, with p^\sharp the identity of A=\mathcal O_X(X); modules over (\{\mathrm{pt}\},A) are A-modules, so its derived category is D(A). Define the derived global sections R\Gamma(X,-):=Rp_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(A), the derived direct image of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]; it is represented by \Gamma(X,\mathcal I^\bullet) for any K-injective resolution K\to\mathcal I^\bullet. For P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_X), define the global derived Hom complex $$R\operatorname{Hom}_X(P,Q):=R\Gamma\bigl(X,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(P,Q)\bigr)\in D(\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)),$$ with R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X} the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. It is functorial in P (contravariantly) and Q (covariantly); when X=\operatorname{Spec}(R) it is an object of D(R), and after forgetting the A-module structure it is an object of the derived category of abelian groups.
